post.caption: This garnet is named after a park. Tsavorite is a variety of garnet colored green by vanadium and chromium, and its color can rival emerald, with more fire and fewer inclusions. Campbell Bridges found the green garnet near Komolo, Tanzania, in about 1967. After Tanzania took over its mines, he registered claims in Kenya, near Tsavo National Park. Bridges and Tiffany named the gem tsavorite after that park, and Tiffany began promoting it in 1974. Cut stones over two carats are rare. The Lion of Merelani, found in 2017, weighs about 117 carats.
